name: BACH_0240
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1] and suggested tumor at three margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Calibrated invasive score (ECE 5%) |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at alpha 10% | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability / 94th percentile OOD [F6] | Unflagged (12/12 regions); borderline atypical |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (81%–86% similarity) [F5] | All reference neighbors match Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive driver (+2.07); above-typical stromal infiltration score (1.69) [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical tubule score (-0.35) pushes read toward invasive (+0.49) [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.43) [F4], but 0/20 on AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scant benign stroma pushes read toward invasive (+0.40) · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low duct confinement (-0.69) pushes read toward invasive (+0.39) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability past random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); discount Unreliable **mitoses** (0/20 AI check), **normal lobules** (0/20), and **necrosis** (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section artifact or 94th-percentile OOD appearance mimics invasion, versus Benign contrast case `BACH_0284` (76% similarity).
- HoVer-Net cell segmentation failed, and validation spans only 132 images across 24 patients (conformal coverage CI 76%–98%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 10**: Confirm true stromal infiltration versus frozen-section artifact at peak invasion hotspots.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 7**: Assess nuclear pleomorphism and mitoses directly; cell segmentation failed and mitotic concept is unreliable.
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8, 11**: Verify tumor at superior (215 um), lateral (215 um), and medial (108 um) margins.
